evidence.observation: This is the repository-discovery layer. It resolves the git repo's HEAD commit (self.repo.head.commit), traverses the commit tree collecting every blob path, adds staged index entries, normalizes each path to a repo-relative POSIX string via normalize_path, and finally returns only `fname for fname in files if not self.ignored_file(fname)`. So the raw file inventory and the ignore filtering are both owned here, and the method emits a plain list of relative filenames with no notion of ranking or map tokens.

This method owns the .aiderignore ignore rules. It rate-limits checks to once per second (aider_ignore_last_check), compares the ignore file's mtime against the cached aider_ignore_ts, and on change reparses the lines into a pathspec.PathSpec built from pathspec.patterns.GitWildMatchPattern. The resulting aider_ignore_spec is the single source of truth consulted later by ignored_file_raw, keeping rule loading separate from both discovery and map construction.

The ignore-decision layer. ignored_file first calls refresh_aider_ignore to keep the spec current, then memoizes per-filename results in ignore_file_cache before delegating to ignored_file_raw. ignored_file_raw applies the subtree_only restriction (rejecting files outside cwd) and then matches the normalized name against aider_ignore_spec. get_tracked_files consumes this to produce the already-filtered file list, so callers such as RepoMap never have to know about .aiderignore or subtree_only.

Repository location/discovery is established here: git.Repo(fname, search_parent_directories=True).working_dir is resolved for each check fname, multiple distinct repos raise 'Files are in different git repos.' (FileNotFoundError), and self.root is fixed to the repo working tree. The aider_ignore_file path is only stored (not parsed) here, deferring rule parsing to refresh_aider_ignore. This confirms git/repo discovery is fully encapsulated in repo.py before RepoMap is constructed.

The RepoMap entry point takes chat_files and other_files as explicit arguments; it performs no filesystem or git discovery of its own. It only computes the token budget (map_mul_no_files when the chat is empty), delegates to get_ranked_tags_map, and wraps the rendered listing with repo_content_prefix. Because file discovery/ignore filtering already happened upstream in GitRepo.get_tracked_files, this method is purely map construction over caller-supplied file lists.

Map-content construction: it unions chat_fnames and other_fnames into a single fname set, parses tags via get_tags/get_tags_raw, builds define/reference/definition graphs (networkx PageRank personalization), and ranks definition nodes. It consumes the file lists passed in and never walks the filesystem or consults git, demonstrating that ranking is decoupled from discovery.

This method turns ranked tags into the final tree under a token budget: it calls get_ranked_tags, separates 'special' filenames via filter_important_files, then binary-searches the number of ranked tags (lower_bound/upper_bound/middle) using to_tree + token_count until the estimate is within ok_err of max_map_tokens. All inputs are file names, so map construction is a self-contained rendering/selection stage over the discovery output.

The only os.walk in repomap.py lives in this module-level helper, and it is used solely by the __main__ debug entrypoint (line 859) to expand directory arguments for manual runs. It is not used by the RepoMap class, confirming that real repository discovery is delegated to GitRepo rather than duplicated in repomap.py.

claims.claim: Repository discovery and path normalization are owned exclusively by aider/repo.py: GitRepo.get_tracked_files enumerates HEAD-commit blobs plus staged index entries, normalizes them with normalize_path, and returns repo-relative filenames, so no other module needs to touch git or os.walk for discovery.

Ignore rules are a distinct layer inside aider/repo.py: refresh_aider_ignore parses .aiderignore into a pathspec GitWildMatchPattern spec (mtime-cached), and ignored_file/ignored_file_raw apply that spec plus subtree_only filtering with a per-filename cache; get_tracked_files consumes these so downstream code sees only allowed files.

Map construction is owned by aider/repomap.py and is decoupled from discovery: RepoMap.get_repo_map, get_ranked_tags and get_ranked_tags_map_uncached operate purely on caller-supplied chat_files/other_files lists, ranking tags and binary-searching a tree to a token budget without any git or filesystem enumeration of the repository.

The separation is enforced by an explicit interface: GitRepo.get_tracked_files() -> base_coder.get_all_relative_files/get_all_abs_files -> other_files passed into RepoMap.get_repo_map; repomap's own find_src_files (os.walk) is used only by its __main__ helper, not by the RepoMap class.

conclusion: The two modules are cleanly layered rather than mixed. aider/repo.py owns the discovery and filtering half: GitRepo.__init__ locates the git repo and fixes root, GitRepo.get_tracked_files enumerates commit-tree blobs plus staged entries, and the ignore layer (refresh_aider_ignore parsing .aiderignore via pathspec, plus ignored_file/ignored_file_raw applying it and subtree_only) filters that inventory into repo-relative filenames. aider/repomap.py owns the construction half: RepoMap.get_repo_map receives chat_files/other_files explicitly, get_ranked_tags builds and ranks a define/reference graph, and get_ranked_tags_map_uncached binary-searches the tag list into a tree within a token budget. repomap.py never performs git discovery or walks the repo (its only os.walk, find_src_files, serves the module's __main__ debug helper), and repo.py never ranks or renders code. The contract between them is a plain list of filenames, with base_coder.get_repo_map computing other_files from repo.get_tracked_files() via get_all_abs_files and passing them in.

import ast, json
checks = {
 ('aider/repo.py','GitRepo.get_tracked_files'):(433,487),
 ('aider/repo.py','GitRepo.refresh_aider_ignore'):(500,521),
 ('aider/repo.py','GitRepo.ignored_file'):(532,565),
 ('aider/repo.py','GitRepo.__init__'):(62,130),
 ('aider/repomap.py','RepoMap.get_repo_map'):(103,168),
 ('aider/repomap.py','RepoMap.get_ranked_tags'):(365,574),
 ('aider/repomap.py','RepoMap.get_ranked_tags_map_uncached'):(629,709),
 ('aider/repomap.py','find_src_files'):(787,796),
}
for (path,name),(s,e) in checks.items():
    src=open(path).read().splitlines()
    tree=ast.parse('\n'.join(src))
    lines=[n.lineno for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef,ast.ClassDef))]
    assert any(l==s for l in lines), (path,name,s)
    assert s<=e<=len(src)
    print('OK',path,name,s,e)
